mapper.select: select * from `cq-hospital`.schedule join `cq-hospital`.doctor on schedule.doctor_id = doctor.id join `cq-hospital`.hospital on schedule.hospital_id = hospital.id join `cq-hospital`.department on schedule.department_id = department.id where doctor.name = #{doctorName} and schedule.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} and hospital.name = #{hospitalName} and department.name = #{departmentName}
